scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
The imported 1600 to 1815 polygon interval does not date the beginning or end of Arabana people. Geometry and exact territorial limits remain unverified.
Arabana and Southern Arrernte identities are distinguished in the photograph account; the card does not assign Jessie an unsupported affiliation.
The Strangways Springs paper was read in selected passages, not in full. Camp evidence concerns the late nineteenth century; no universal precolonial household pattern is inferred.
The head ornament’s materials are tentative and maker unrecorded. The 1917 collection date is not presented as a separately established manufacture date.
The water report’s executive summary and specified pages were read. Publisher and repository copies count as one work for quotation and paraphrase limits.
Language exhibition evidence distinguishes Arabana from Tanganekald. The card does not attribute Tanganekald recordings to Arabana speakers.
The 2025 burn was reported as a trial. No ecological recovery outcome or present opening of the Warli centre is asserted.
Native title area figures, an exact lease-return date and a disputed precise lake-renaming date are omitted. No current legal advice is supplied.
Source checking supports the stated claims; independent review, depth certification and geometry review remain pending.
